name: DBIM
tagline: Diffusion Bridge Implicit Model: deterministic-stochastic transition with eta-controlled noise that interpolates between bridge endpoints.
diff_from_baseline: Zheng et al. 2024 (ICLR). Diffusion Bridge Implicit Models: deterministic/stochastic generalization of DDIM for diffusion bridges, supporting low-NFE sampling.

name: DBIM (high-order)
tagline: DBIM with multistep predictor-corrector updates: 2nd/3rd-order extrapolation in log-SNR using cached past denoiser outputs.

key_hyperparams.name: lower_order_final
key_hyperparams.role: drop to 1st order on final step

diff_from_baseline: Zheng et al. 2024. High-order variant of DBIM analogous to DPM-Solver-2/3: uses cached past $\hat{x}_0$ predictions and exponential-integrator coefficients in log-SNR for higher accuracy at low NFE.

name: DDBM (50 NFE)
tagline: Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models reference sampler: Karras-style ρ=7 schedule with churn (Euler) + Heun second-order steps, 50 total denoiser calls.
diff_from_baseline: Zhou et al. 2024 (ICML). Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models reference sampler. Provided as the 50-NFE upper-bound reference; agents target similar quality at 5 NFE.

name: ECSI
tagline: Endpoint-Conditioned Stochastic Interpolant sampler: Euler-SDE with analytic VP derivatives plus a final 2-step deterministic DBIM tail for inpainting safety.
diff_from_baseline: Zhang et al. 2024 (arXiv:2410.21553, 'Exploring the Design Space of Diffusion Bridge Models'). Endpoint-conditioned stochastic interpolant sampler with VP-analytic derivatives; reference implementation github.com/szhan311/ECSI.
